caption: AI Status
description: Container for per-operation outcome scalars contributed by the ai_operation profile. Holds outcomes reported by the model or agent runtime — e.g. why a completion stopped, permission decisions, context-compaction reasons, sub-agent stop reasons — so they do not proliferate as discrete attributes at the event root. Attributes are added here as their taxonomies are defined.
name: ai_status

stop_reason.caption: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: The reason the model completion ended, as reported by the event source. Normalized to the caption of the stop_reason_id value; when the value is 'Other', this carries the event source's native label (e.g. end_turn, max_tokens).

stop_reason_id.caption: Stop Reason ID
stop_reason_id.description: The normalized reason the model completion ended. Producers map their runtime's native value into this set. Populate on completion events; when the value is 'Other', set stop_reason to the event source's native label. Because completion behavior is bound to the configuration that produced it, a shift in this attribute's distribution is more meaningful when weighed against that configuration: ai_model.version for direct model invocations, and ai_agent.version, ai_agent.charter, and ai_agent.instance_uid for agent-mediated operations.

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The completion ended without the producer being able to determine why, so the state of the operation at termination is not established.

1.caption: End of Turn
1.description: The model reached the end of its turn: it completed its response naturally or emitted a configured stop sequence, and is not waiting on anything further.

2.caption: Token Limit
2.description: The completion was truncated by a token or length limit before the model finished, so the response is incomplete.

3.caption: Tool Use
3.description: The completion paused to invoke a tool. The turn is not finished; the model expects the tool result and will continue.

4.caption: Session Stop
4.description: The completion ended because the session or connection carrying it terminated - for example the caller cancelled, the client disconnected, or the transport closed - rather than because the model reached a stopping point. The session state at termination is therefore known, which distinguishes this from Unknown and lets a consumer decide whether the operation needs investigation or can simply be reclaimed.

5.caption: Content Filter
5.description: The completion was stopped by a safety, policy, or content moderation mechanism rather than by the model reaching a stopping point or by the caller. This includes a refusal raised by a safety classifier and a guardrail intervening on the request or the response.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The stop reason is not mapped. See the stop_reason attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

permission_result_id.caption: Permission Result ID
permission_result_id.description: The normalized outcome of the agent runtime's permission check for this operation, as reported by the runtime. Normalized taxonomy to be defined.

compaction_reason_id.caption: Compaction Reason ID
compaction_reason_id.description: The normalized reason the agent runtime compacted context during this operation, as reported by the runtime. Normalized taxonomy to be defined.

subagent_stop_reason_id.caption: Sub-agent Stop Reason ID
subagent_stop_reason_id.description: The normalized reason a sub-agent spawned during this operation stopped, as reported by the runtime. Normalized taxonomy to be defined.
